title: LatchCreateSessionRequestV2
description: The only caller-controlled inputs for a mobile-created session: where it starts, optionally which hosted agent the Mac launches there instead of a standard shell, and optionally a short orientation the agent receives as system-level instructions.

agent.description: Hosted agent to launch directly in the session. Absent means a standard login shell. The Mac resolves the agent's own executable and launch arguments; the caller names only the kind, and only a kind the gateway advertises in features.sessionAgents.

model.description: Model the agent starts with, passed to it as `--model`. Only valid with `agent`, and only an id the gateway lists for that agent at GET /v2/agents/{agent}/models. Absent means the agent's own configured default on the Mac.

reasoningEffort.description: Thinking level for the named agent and explicit model. Send only a value in that model's reasoningOptions, as advertised by this host. Absent uses the agent's configured effort.

instructions.description: Orientation text the agent receives through its own system-level instruction mechanism (Claude Code: --append-system-prompt; Codex: developer_instructions), never as a user message. Only valid with `agent`, only for an agent listed in features.sessionInstructions.agents, and at most features.sessionInstructions.maxBytes UTF-8 bytes. Tab and newline are the only control characters accepted. Absent means the agent starts with no injected text; a gateway that predates the field refuses the key, so a caller sends it only when advertised.
